newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Garanti Bankasi to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Turk Garanti Bankasi to raise capital.

text.p: Turkey's private commercial bank, Turkiye Garanti Bankasi AS, has decided to raise its capital to 40 trillion lira from 18 trillion lira, the Istanbul Stock Exchange said in a statement.
The bank will issue 14,156 billion lira of rights or 0.7864-for-one-existing share, and 7,844 billion lira of bonuses or 0.4357-for-one-existing share, it said.
It also plans to give out cash dividend in the amount of rights issue.
The capital increase is subject to the approval in the bank's ordinary partners' general assembly meeting on March 28.
Garanti shares are also listed in London Stock Exchange and traded on SEAQ market.
